text: Old Garrick leans over his stall. "A birthday, is it? Well, your coin buys any one of these."
A paper twist of honey sweets.
A ribbon the colour of cornflowers.
A little wooden bird, carved by hand.
"Sweets for the sweet," Garrick chuckles, and wraps them tight.
"She'll wear that till it's rags," Garrick says, folding it neatly.
Garrick smiles. "Took me a week, that one. It'll last her a lifetime."
